{{dablink|For other uses of the word "water," see [[Water (disambiguation)|Water]].}}
The '''Water Way''' is a philosophy followed by the [[Amayar]], the fair-skinned natives of [[Tremalking]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Water Way, the}} It is a very peaceful way of life similar to the [[Way of the Leaf]], and its followers prize acceptance on what it is, rather than what might be wished for.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 19}}

It is unknown whether the Water Way continued to live on anywhere in the world after the Amayar's mass suicide following the [[Cleansing of saidin|Cleansing of ''saidin'']].{{ref/book|11|22}}
